title: DashboardAuthoringResponse
description: 200 response body of POST /api/authoring/dashboard (HEL-392) — a schema-valid DashboardProposal grounded in the caller's real workspace and validated via the same checks DashboardProposalService.apply uses. The proposal is NOT applied by this call — applying stays the caller's explicit, separate action via POST /api/dashboards/apply-proposal.

warnings.description: Degrade-not-fail notices collected while assembling the grounding context (e.g. a per-DataType panel-capability fetch that failed) — never a reason the call itself failed. Always present, possibly empty.
